primary_meaning: A consecrated day of cessation from ordinary labor that commemorates God’s rest after creation, serves as a covenant sign of belonging to God, and typologically points to the spiritual rest believers enter through Christ.

alternatives.meaning: The weekly Sabbath remains the literal seventh day (Saturday) as a continuing moral obligation for Christians
The Sabbath principle is transferred to Sunday (the Lord’s Day) in honor of the resurrection
The Sabbath commandment is entirely fulfilled and abolished in Christ; no particular day is required
An eschatological symbol of the coming millennial or eternal rest of God’s people

notes: Across historic Christian interpretation the core symbolic cluster of sacred rest, creation memorial, and christological fulfillment is stable; divergence concerns only the ongoing calendrical application or degree of continuity with the Mosaic form.
